thought.text: Boards is up (951MB free). Now restart app (last one, build cached):

reasoning_content: boards is up (951MB available). I've temporarily stopped app to secure memory for the boards build. Now, restart app (the last one). At this point the memory situation is: cms (approx. 1.8GB) + boards (approx. 1.5GB) are running, and there are 10 containers. app needs about 2GB for the build. Currently available is 951MB, and after the build completes the steady state should be no problem. Let me try starting app now.

action.command:
cd /workspace
export GITHUB_TOKEN="ghp_dummytesttoken0000000000000000000000"
export JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-21-openjdk-amd64; export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"
setsid nohup bash -c 'exec just serve --apps=app < /dev/zero' > /tmp/fin-app2.log 2>&1 &
echo "app pid $!"
for i in $(seq 1 11); do
  code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 3 -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1:39001/ 2>/dev/null)
  if [ "$code" = "200" ]; then echo "app UP check $i"; break; fi
  # detect if cms or boards got OOM-killed
  c=$(curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 2 -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1:39002/ 2>/dev/null)
  b=$(curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 2 -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1:39003/ 2>/dev/null)
  echo "check $i: app=$code cms=$c boards=$b avail=$(free -m | sed -n '2p' | awk '{print $6}')MB"
  sleep 45
done
